newsitem.title: USA: Man shot at Versace mansion in Miami Beach.
newsitem.headline: Man shot at Versace mansion in Miami Beach.

text.p: A man was shot and wounded on Tuesday outside the Miami Beach mansion of world-famous fashion designer Gianni Versace, police said.
The identity of the victim was not immediately known, Miami Beach spokesman Al Boza told reporters.

Local television station WPLG, an ABC affiliate, quoted unconfirmed reports that Versace himself had been shot. A spokeswoman for Jackson Memorial Hospital would not immediately confirm the victim's identity.
"I'm waiting for confirmation right now from our trauma centre," she said.
